source_policy: Primary official sources only; registry metadata is used for published package facts; documentation claims are not substituted for prototype execution evidence.
currentness_policy: Words such as current, stable, and latest are dated observations at the associated cutoff or refresh. A scheduled release is not treated as available at the earlier cutoff; a later official release is recorded as a currentness correction and does not retroactively change prototype chronology.
locator_policy: Prefer immutable release tags and full commits; use section anchors for standards/policy; record a short tag commit when GitHub did not expose the full object through the retrieved page.

failures.request: Initial search-index current Lean/Mathlib release resolution
failures.outcome: stale result labeled v4.30.0 as latest
failures.preservation: The original August 3 re-query corrected v4.30.0 to the then-observed v4.32.1 matching pair. A separate August 5 currentness audit opened the exact official Mathlib v4.32.2 release, its immutable revision 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c, and its tagged lean-toolchain selecting Lean v4.32.2. The recommendation source was therefore corrected to the immutable v4.32.2 pair after direct prototype evidence, while the v4.32.1 observation remains explicitly superseded historical evidence.
Repository license classification retained from the official repository page; no raw-file quotation used.

failures.request: Direct Rust/Cargo 2026 advisory URLs inferred from the Rust blog index
failures.preservation: The original failed inferred URLs produced no security claim. The August 5 refresh independently located the exact official Rust Security Response Team posts at https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/05/25/cve-2026-5222/ and https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/05/25/cve-2026-5223/. Their affected ranges and mitigations are now recorded directly; RustSec remains cited only for crate advisory infrastructure.

currentness_corrections.subject: Mathlib matching release
currentness_corrections.original_observation: On August 3, the retrieved releases response exposed v4.32.1 as the latest matching Mathlib release.
currentness_corrections.corrected_observation: On August 5, the exact official v4.32.2 release page exposed immutable revision 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c and the tagged lean-toolchain selected leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2.
currentness_corrections.disposition: v4.32.1 is retained as superseded evidence; v4.32.2 is the current matching source pair.

currentness_corrections.subject: CPython development-release currentness
currentness_corrections.original_observation: Python 3.14.6 was current and Python 3.14.7 was only scheduled at the August 3 probe cutoff.
currentness_corrections.corrected_observation: The official Python release page records Python 3.14.7 as released on August 5 and marks 3.14.6 superseded.
currentness_corrections.disposition: 3.14.6 remains the exact historical tested SQ-0002 pin. 3.14.7 is the current source release, and the 20260805 managed-runtime artifact has separate immutable provenance; its actual probe result must be taken only from the matrix and retained logs.

prototype_boundary: These files establish source lineage, versions, licenses, policy, and documented limitations. They do not claim that StatQED builds, packages, validates CBOR/CDDL, or round-trips Arrow on any host. Those are prototype/test obligations.
